Allyra wriggled within Nicolas’s grip, causing him to become obviously excited. Neither mentioned the issue that sat between them.
‘I will take my chances and decline your kind offer.’ 
Nicolas sighed,
‘I am saddened to hear that. I am more than saddened, I am deeply wounded. Poor Nicolas.’ 
‘This is nuts, I only met you a few hours ago. What are you on about?’ 
Nicolas tightened his grip,
‘Nicolas is sad, but he has not given up. He shall woo you in a more traditional manner.’ 
‘That’s great. Can I go?’ 
‘Nicolas is heartbroken,’ Nicolas continued, ‘but he shall prevail. Nicolas always wins.’
Allyra waited for his fake sad face to pass, then spoke again,
‘Nic, can we pick this discussion up again, I have a few people to meet and some business to attend to.’
‘Madam, I would not wish to infringe upon you in anyway, but may I ask, are you meeting a man friend perhaps?’
‘I have a gentleman who has been in my life some five years. He is working in Neferaten today, but I promised to meet him tonight. We have an… Arrangement.’
Nicolas squinted, forcing Allyra to elaborate,
‘We have an open relationship.’ 
‘Ahhh,’ Nicolas nodded, ‘And what is the gentleman’s name?’
‘Chester, The Cat.’

Nicolas did not seem remotely annoyed by this, in fact the soft smile on his face suggested he was almost pleased. Or gloating,
‘The Pied Piper. Yes. I have heard of him. Very popular with the ladies. Legendary. You must be very special if he has stuck around for five years.’ 
‘I’m sorry, Nic.’
‘You probably will be. I have already told you the outcome of this matter, it is only the route that will be affected. It seems you wish to take a more difficult pathway.’ 
Allyra tilted her head,
‘You don’t get told no very often, do you?’

Nicolas stared at Allyra. It was not a comfortable stare, but an icy cold glare. He did not blink. He did not move but sat quite rigidly, and turgidly, beneath her. His grip remained oppressive, then his eyes rolled upwards, and he stayed that way for ten minutes. The whispers growled around Allyra and again she ignored them.

At first, Allyra tried to shift off of his lap, but his arms were quite resolved to keeping her in position. Allyra watched the clock on the wall. Its hands moved rhythmically, then stuttered, and then returned to the original dance. After precisely ten minutes Nicolas’s eyes floated back into position,
‘You were saying?’ He asked as if nothing peculiar had happened.
‘I was saying no.’ 
Nicolas smirked, then his eyes rolled back into his head again, and this time he held the pose for twenty minutes. Allyra puffed out an exacerbated breath of air and reverted to looking at the clock again. The hands stopped, fidgeted, then moved in reverse. Allyra sighed and waited for the Nicolas show to finish its act.

Eventually, Nicolas returned to insanity and asked again,
‘You were saying Madam?’
Allyra bit her lip,
‘I said nothing.’ 
‘And an improvement it is!’ 
Allyra tried to struggle free again, but Nicolas tightened his grip,
‘Why are you doing this, Nic?’ Allyra asked.
‘Doing what?’ 
‘Following me.’
Nicolas groaned under his breath,
‘Madam, I already told you, I am courting. Perhaps when you return to Corax, Dr Smythe can test your hearing.’
‘I can hardly return to somewhere I have never been.’
Nicolas continued to stare at her. His tongue then escaped from his mouth and scrubbed a nasty long lick around her face,
‘Of course you can return. You cannot not return as it would be detrimental to the science of linguistics.’
‘You have not answered my question, Nic, and don’t keep licking me. I’m not a pot roast.’
‘You may be yet!’ Nicolas exclaimed, his voice vibrant and animated, ‘or a spit roast.’
‘That’s a horrible thing to say.’

Nicolas leaned his head into Allyra’s chest,
‘One last chance. Come home to Corax with me and let us forget all this legal nonsense.’ 
Allyra could not decide if Nicolas was serious or setting a trap, or both,
‘I have a prior engagement in Sapari.’
‘And where might this engagement be occurring?’
‘The Tavern,’ Allyra frowned, ‘why do you talk like that?’
‘Of what are you speaking?’ Nicolas replied. 
‘Never mind.’ 

Allyra looked over Nicolas’s face, he was not unattractive, but he was certainly not what one would call handsome. His hair was excessively oily, masking the natural streaks of auburn. His face was not much better. He had a nasty blood stain clamped to his lower left lip, and a film of dirt suffocating his skin. His cheeks were nicely angled, and his eyes shone a sympathetic emerald. 

Allyra could not help but touch Nicolas’s hair, mostly out of curiosity,
‘Is that lard in your hair?’ She asked.
‘Grade-A thesapien lard, yes indeed,’ Nicolas smiled.
Allyra cast her eye over Nicolas’s suit. The clothes were obviously new but did nothing to hide the noxious airs that floated about him.

As if reading her thoughts, the window sprung open welcoming in a breeze of fresh air. Allyra inhaled with a sense of relief, but once again any relief was short-lived. A swarm of flies had taken it upon themselves to follow the breeze into the building and were instantly attracted to Nicolas’s raw scent. The flies buzzed about his hat with quite a determination to secure his attention. Nicolas did not move. Allyra attempted to waft the flies away with her hand, but the flies were adamant about remaining and stood in protest on the rim of Nicolas’s top hat. Allyra wondered if Nicolas could see properly,
‘Nic, you’re attracting flies.’
Nicolas snorted in a most repulsive and slimy manner,
‘Madam, I am dealing with your enquiry at present, the flies must wait their turn like everyone else.’ 
‘It’s not very nice, is it?’ 
Nicolas snorted again, chewed whatever nastiness he had snorted in his mouth, then slid his tongue over Allyra’s lips. She grimaced,
‘Why though?’ 

Since Allyra had not reacted in the usual horrified manner of the ladies of the Deep and responded to his attentions with the smack of a broom or succumb to some horrific accident, Nicolas decided that she must be more in love with him than he had imagined and decided to gift her with the romantic cherry on the cake. He sucked in a mouthful of air, swallowed it, and tensed his stomach and jaw.
‘What are you doing now?’ Allyra asked, even though something inside her told her not to encourage him. With that Nicolas heaved, then heaved again. Allyra tried to unpick his fingers, but it was too late. A projectile spray of dark red, mushy blood vomited from his mouth and soaked his potential mate. Allyra opened her mouth to protest, and another spray belted her in the face, splattering her teeth and gums. She wiped her lips and mouth with her fingers and wiped the vomit from her eyes. Since she had not slapped Nicolas, he assumed she was giving him a huge come-on and relieved his belly of another tank full of vomit-blood. 

Allyra rocked on his lap, which thickened the girth pressing against her ass. She rubbed the vomit from her face and chest, but this simply caused it to stain and spread. Nicolas smiled, happy with his romantic offerings,
‘I have decided that you may attend the tavern tonight for a short time, and I will seek you out for further courting later today, and also tonight.’ 
‘You have decided, have you?’
‘No need to thank me. I am a gracious lord, providing you are amicable to my good selves.’

Allyra sighed,
‘So, we have moved from third person singular to first person plural?’
‘Indeed, we have. Now that we know each other more intimately, we feel we can be ourselves.’ 
Allyra thought for a moment, and decided to use Nicolas’s bizarre admiration to her advantage,
‘Nic?’
‘Yes.’
‘Are you going to kill me like the others? Is this part of what you do?’
Nicolas’s eyes widened, and his jaw dropped,
‘Indeed no. How could you even think such a thing?’
‘Because that is the purpose of this whole charade, isn’t it?’
Nicolas took a moment to lick her again, dripping more rancid, dribble and blood over her skin,
‘I do not care for the charade. We have chosen our bride. Nicolas will not let anything happen to her because Nicolas would be sad and that is what matters.’

A long silence fell upon the room. Nicolas spent the silence tilting his head whilst staring at Allyra. He shifted beneath her, primarily because inflexible things were getting a little uncomfortable, then the muttering started, 
‘Felippe, go to the mirror,’ he said, ‘take one of the tributes from the embassy’s dungeon… Of course not this side. The other side. No, the other side.’ Nicolas tutted, sighed and then added, ‘Hurry up about it.’ He then smirked at Allyra, who had resolved not to give the Nicolas show anymore attention, and said, ‘Does the lady have any objections to a small dalliance?’ 
‘A dalliance?’
‘Yes,’ Nicolas said as one arm loosened and his hand dropped between her legs.
‘It isn’t permitted,’ Allyra replied.
Nicolas leaned forward as his fingers gently brushed against her, 
‘I won’t mention it to anyone!’
‘Nic, I am not sleeping with you,’ Allyra said through deepening breaths.

Nicolas’s fingers pressed harder and his lips brushed against her neck,
‘Of course you are not,’ he added as his mouth rose to meet hers. His hand withdraw, loosened her trousers and drifted down the front of her thong. Allyra involuntarily parted her legs, and the weight of her body pressed into the arm securing her.

Behind the office’s two-way mirror, in a small secret room, Felippe sat on a throne facing the mirror. The tribute that accompanied him knelt between his legs and he lowered his trousers, forcing his cock into her readily open mouth. His fingers grasped her hair and he used the motion of his hand to direct her oral gait. 

Nicolas glanced at the mirror and smiled. His middle finger bled into Allyra’s need and he strummed it up and down, increasing the pace until every last element of Allyra’s resistance left her body. He then peeled the trousers off of her flesh and pushed her body supine across the width of his desk, so that her head hung over the edge. His mouth found her with haste, replacing the errant finger. His tongue locked onto her flesh, lengthened and circled her causing her to moan, cry out, then writhe against his hunger. 

Felippe’s wrist increased in both pressure and speed, forcing the tribute to take him deeper into her throat. Felippe felt it. Nicolas felt it. Both could taste the musky scent of their future bride. 

Nicolas’s finger found its way inside of Allyra and she pressed against it, then another followed, and a third. Allyra shook under his touch,
‘Fuck me, Nic,’ she pleaded. Nicolas did not respond, opting instead to maintain the current motion of both his tongue and his hand. His body moved rhythmically as if being pumped into an invisible guest. He groaned. Felippe groaned. Nicolas flicked the index finger of his free hand at the mirror and Felippe pulled himself from the tribute’s mouth. He dragged her to her feet and pressed her face against the glass before entering her with a spiteful and harsh thrust.

Allyra wrapped her legs about Nicolas’s neck and rolled her hips backwards and forwards with each lick,
‘Please, Nic, take me.’ 
Nicolas had no intention of being commanded to do anything and was quite happy where he was. Allyra groaned again and her body clenched around Nicolas’s fingers. 

Felippe held the back of the tribute’s neck and slammed in and out of her at haste. His teeth tore chunks of flesh from her neck and shoulders as his excitement built. The experience reverberated within Nicolas. He could taste the tribute’s blood just as he could taste Allyra. 

As Allyra’s moaning filled the embassy, Chives quietly opened the door, drank in the scene for a while, then closed it again. 

Felippe pressed his weight down on the tribute’s shoulders and she dropped to the floor. His body sprawled across hers. The palms of his hands pressed into the wooden boards. His face elongated. Nicolas’s face elongated, but Allyra did not notice. Felippe pushed his own body weight up, and his massive form arched over the still living body of his victim. Savagely, his teeth ripped chunks from the tribute’s cheek, her back, her arms and her delightful neck. She tried to scream, but talons ripped the vocal cords from her throat before any sound was released. They were consumed at haste and his teeth returned to her body. 

Allyra’s stomach knotted and waved. She moved more aggressively and wantonly against her nemesis’s mouth, quite forgetting her dignity and position. Nicolas’s tongue lengthened further and knotted about her entirety. 

Felippe’s talons drifted to the tribute’s sternum. The strong nails pressed inward breaking through the flesh. They hooked beneath either side of her rib cage as Felippe shifted to a kneeling position. His prey was dragged upwards. He gripped her ribs and yanked outwards tearing them open and wrenching them from her body.

Nicolas could not hold back. His hand and tongue worked Allyra harder. Her body clenched and ached. She tried to resist the painful climax, but nothing could stop it. The electric pulses raged through her and she yelled Nicolas’s name through gritted teeth as she surrendered herself to his touch.

The tribute shook and trembled. She gasped for air. Her eyes lost their shine, and as the last light left her body both Felippe and Nicolas spent their pent up fury. 

Felippe despised waste, it was an environmental travesty, so, as Nicolas licked his lips and fingers clean, Felippe ate the remains of his tribute. Once Nicolas had finished snacking on whatever was coating his hand, he pulled The Busty Bride from his inside pocket and turned the pages whilst Allyra dressed herself.

‘Mmmm, yes. No, I don’t think so,’ Nicolas muttered.
Allyra secured her trousers and sat on the desk,
‘What’s the matter with you now?’ She asked coyly. Her cheeks were flushed with both her pleasure and the slightly awkward embarrassment that filled her.
‘Ridiculous,’ Nicolas laughed, ‘listen to this…’
‘Do I have to?’ 
‘Yes, Madam, you do. I just made every effort to please you, now you have to listen to me. It’s called equity, Dr Riesigerschwanz told me all about it. He made it adamantly clear, if I please you, you are obliged to do as I say, that is how relationships work. I don’t know how we are supposed to get married when you don’t even know the basics.’ 
‘I’m not marrying you, Nic, I told you this. I don’t want to get married. Not to you. Not to Chester. Not to anyone. I have my own plans.’
‘IT SAYS,’ Nicolas bellowed to drown out Allyra’s protests, ‘as she lay in the afterglow, he placed his hands on her body and massaged her skin with the tenderness of a lover smitten. For hours he kneaded her shoulders and back…’ Nicolas snorted, ‘Yes, I can’t be bothered with all that. It seems a little one sided too. In fairness, if anyone should be massaging anyone, then it should be you massaging me for my astounding performance or at least giving me some money.’

Allyra’s jaw dropped in response to Nicolas’s magnanimous monologue,
‘That is a little insulting, Nic.’
Nicolas ignored her and parked his regal behind in his chair,
‘Aftercare, what absolute nonsense. I am a busy man, I don’t have to be a voluntary physiotherapist, no matter what strange woman ideas you have about it.’
‘I never mentioned it,’ Allyra sighed, ‘you brought all this up when, literally, no one asked!’
‘Next you will want jewellery and chocolates. I have seen you sniffing around the chocolate eclairs in the Sapari bakery, and flowers, you will want them too. I shall be inundated with bees. Then you will ask me to move furniture around only to have me move it all back the next day. You will probably want scented candles delivered daily. Then it will be, Nicolas would you love me if I was a slug? And all that entrapment, before you know it, Corax will be a Tupperware shop filled with free women who all hate me. No, this won’t do. I don’t think I should marry you at all, not with this attitude.’
‘Good, don’t,’ Allyra snapped.
Nicolas pursed his lips, twitched and snorted again,
‘Worry nor, fair maiden, for I shall overlook these failures that saturate my queen’s troubled heart.’

Allyra contemplated asking him again why he spoke in such a weird way, but guessed he would just misfire again or talk more gibberish, and she could not be bothered with either,
‘So, what happens now?’
‘Now? Past. Present and future, or just present?’
‘Any.’
Nicolas cleared his throat, which was a tad slimy,
‘A raven shall carry you yonder and a friend and a stranger shall seduce you as one does when one is one, then you shall drown in my oblivion, marry me as you promised, and lock yourself in a birdcage.’ 
Allyra waved her hand,
‘Never mind. May I leave?’
‘Indeed, I must prepare for our date tonight.’
‘Whatever you say, Nic.’ 
‘That’s the spirit,’ Nicolas grinned, ‘now you wish to go to the Sapari Tavern?’ 
‘I do.’
‘I will hear that again within three moons,’ Nicolas smirked.
‘I’m sure you hear it all the time.’
Nicolas’s mouth opened again, astonished by Allyra’s intuitive mind,
‘Madam, you are correct. Have you ever been told that you must be psychic?’

Allyra had given up talking and let Nicolas continue,
‘We must, unfortunately, delay your movement to enable our good self, the Pied Piper, to pork his way through the sands of Neferaten. I sense that matters are not going his way and it will take him longer than one usually takes to deliver the post!’
Allyra shook out her hands,
‘I am supposed to meet Chester after his shift.’
‘He’s running late,’ Nicolas snapped, ‘I just told you this.’
‘How would you know?’ 
Nicolas’s eyes shifted from side to side,
‘Would you do me a service, Immoless?’ 
‘What?’ 
‘I should like you to sit in my chair, just stand and I shall move, and then you sit.’
Allyra tutted,
‘I’m not a dog.’
Nicolas’s face dropped, and he made every effort to look hurt,
‘Please, humour me!’

Nicolas stood and allowed Allyra to sit, albeit uncomfortably and a little suspiciously, in his chair.
‘Excellent,’ Nicolas smiled, ‘it suits you, Immoless.’ He moved his face in front of hers. His eyes flashed bright green. Allyra’s eyes whitened in response. 
‘Time, time, time.’ Nicolas murmured, ‘You can wait there quietly until Ches returns. When you wake you shall be convinced that you chose to stay and we had a very romantic dinner together.’ Nicolas clicked his fingers, and Allyra’s eyes closed completely. 

Nicolas took out his pocket watch and watched as each second ticked by. Every clock in Sapari stopped. Every watch stopped and Nicolas remained still for hours.

Eventually Webster appeared in the glass of Nicolas’s pocket watch,
‘I am pleased to inform you that Chester’s day was most successful. Cedric, Ledgerly and Pauley have assisted. Chester has dined, changed, and is on his way to Sapari as I speak.’
‘Excellent,’ Nicolas said. 

The clocks resumed their movements.

Nicolas clicked his finger in Allyra’s face,
‘Did you enjoy your dinner, Immoless?’ He asked.
‘Yes, thank you, I,’ Allyra hesitated, ‘actually no, I…’
Nicolas opted to ignore the glitch and interrupted,
‘Now, we must depart. I shall escort you to the tavern, and you shall reward me with a kiss, to show everyone who you belong to.’ 
‘I can escort my…’ Allyra’s protest was cut short. 

Nicolas pulled her from the chair, dragged her to the window and dropped the two of them into a crouching position. Intestines spewed about Allyra, then a pulsating heart, followed by a liver and bone. Then came muscle, flesh and skin, and finally feathers smoothly formed around them. Instinctively Allyra clung to Nicolas,
‘What’s happening?’ She asked, her voice muffled by the raven’s body that smothered her.
‘I’m taking you where you wish to go.’

The raven that engulfed Allyra and Nicolas trotted about the floor, then took flight, darting through the window and shooting backwards into the sky as lightening kissed its bleak beak. The bird soared, circled Sapari an unnecessary amount of times, and landed outside of the tavern. The feathers retracted first, then the skin, flesh, bone and organs until Allyra was left on the quayside vomiting in Nicolas’s arms. Nicolas was extremely flattered by Allyra’s digestive offerings and held her close to him. He wiped her mouth with his sleeve, declared that he would never wash the love offerings from his suit or indeed ever wash his suit again, then stood her up. Allyra dizzied and fell, but Nicolas caught her,
‘Is that your first flight?’
Allyra nodded, then fell again enabling Nicolas to catch her again. This pleased Nicolas. He pushed his shoulders back, and spoke with a deeper voice,
‘You are saved, my queen.’
Allyra did not answer but talk of the scene quickly drifted through the sprawling gossip train taking the story of Nicolas and Allyra’s torrid love affair from the outside of the tavern to the inside of the tavern, and Banshee came out for a nose.

Nicolas grabbed Allyra and swung her backwards over his arm, lowered her body, and shoved his face into hers,
‘Alas, my queen, I must depart and prepare for tonight,’ Nicolas said as loudly as possible, then pulled Allyra up, grabbed both of her shoulders firmly and plunged his tongue deep into her throat, whilst allowing his lips to grind against hers. His body found itself grinding against her as well. Allyra did not find his lips as offensive as she initially thought, indeed, Nicolas was growing on her. Her own mouth responded to him. Nicolas then stepped back, bowed and sunk into the raven before departing.

text:
Chameleons have long been a symbol of adaptation because of their ability to adjust their iridophores—a special layer of cells under the skin—to blend in with their surroundings.

In a new study published today in Nature Communications, researchers from South Korea have created a robot chameleon capable of imitating its biological counterpart, paving the way for new artificial camouflage technology.

Using color sensors, tiny heaters made of silver nanowires, and thermochromic materials, which change color when exposed to different temperatures, the team was able to re-create multiple high-resolution skin patterns that allowed the robot to transition between colors almost instantly.

Previous ventures into artificial camouflage have often relied on microfluidic devices, which use tiny channels to control the flow of fluids inside, but this project takes a fully electric approach.

Seung Hwan Ko, a professor of thermal engineering at Seoul National University and one of the authors of the study, says the most challenging part was getting the color transition up to nature’s speed. Using the nanowire heaters, which heat up very fast, helped solve that problem: the artificial skin warmed quickly enough to change color at a similar speed to the real animal’s.  

“[Building] a first prototype was very slow,” says Hwan Ko. The first step was determining if the robot would be modeled after a vertebrate—an animal with a backbone—or an invertebrate, like a squid or an octopus. Since an invertebrate model could offer more freedom of movement, the team initially made plans to mimic the octopus, but Hwan Ko says that idea proved “too ambitious.”

After fiddling with different designs and material structures, the team finally decided to tackle the simpler form of the chameleon itself. By shaping the nanowires into simple patterns composed of dots, lines, or scale shapes, they were able to create the complex effect shown in this video.

Although previous research into artificial camouflage has often been tagged for military use, Hwan Ko hopes their work will have a wider impact, particularly in the fields of transportation, beauty, and fashion. Future applications could include cars that adapt their colors to stand out, and even color-changing cloth.

“This chameleon skin, the surface, basically is a kind of display,” he says. “It can be used for a soft or stretchable or flexible display.”

Because the technology is temperature-dependent, though, it doesn’t work as well in extreme cold, which can make it harder for the faux chameleon to realize the full spectrum of color.

Ramses Martinez, an assistant professor at Purdue University who also studies bio-inspired robotics, says that translating other biologically inspired systems into new technologies could lead to more possibilities, including systems that help locate survivors after an earthquake.

The sheer number of lies from these officers during this DUI checkpoint is unbelievable to witness. These guys confront them on all the lies in real time. 

​In Murfreesboro, Tennessee, a joint DUI sobriety checkpoint conducted by the Murfreesboro Police Department (MPD) and the Tennessee Highway Patrol (THP) turned into an exercise in bad-faith policing when an independent journalist decided to legally roll through the stop while recording.

What unfolded wasn’t a routine safety measure, it was a clinic in procedural dishonesty and predatory enforcement tactics.

​The interaction unravels across multiple blatant deceptions listed below. 

 ​The Manufactured Pretext for Detention: Upon pulling up, a female officer labels the stop a "field sobriety checkpoint" and directs the vehicle over to a parking lot. When Murfreesboro Police Sergeant Cox (Badge #269) approaches, he immediately orders the driver out of the vehicle and formally detains him.

 When challenged on reasonable articulable suspicion, Cox asserts he detected "the odor of alcohol." There was just one glaring issue, the driver and nobody else in the vehicle have consumed absolutely zero alcohol.

Claiming to smell alcohol where none exists is the oldest pretext in the playbook, deployed to manufacture artificial probable cause and strip motorists of their Fourth Amendment protections.

 ​The "Freedom Trailer" and Jurisdictional Wordplay: Parked prominently on site was a mobile processing unit, dubbed the "freedom trailer", used during aggressive "No Refusal" operations to execute expedited warrants and conduct involuntary, forced blood draws on drivers.

When pressed on how this operation was funded and governed within Murfreesboro city limits, officers deflected by claiming the equipment belonged to Smyrna authorities and the state, evading accountability for bringing involuntary bodily intrusion trailers to public streets.

 ​The Trap on Driver Rights: During the detention, the driver asked Sergeant Cox about the advance warning signs placed before the checkpoint, pointing out that drivers must have a legal way out. Cox conceded on camera that motorists legally have the right to execute a legal U-turn or turnaround prior to entering the checkpoint without being pulled over solely for avoiding it.

​Caught Red-Handed Hunting Drivers: After being cleared without charges, the journalist parked nearby and returned on foot with warning signs. What did they witness? The exact opposite of what Sergeant Cox claimed. Chase units, including Tennessee Highway Patrol troopers, were parked down the road specifically hunting down, pursuing, and pulling over every motorist making a legal turn to avoid the stop.

When confronted directly with their supervisor’s own words, the officers offered deflections and excuses before rapidly packing up their gear and terminating the entire checkpoint early.

​Public safety cannot be built on fabricated claims, coerced detentions, and hunting down citizens who exercise their legal rights. When police officers can manufacture an odor out of thin air and lie about your right to avoid arbitrary government dragnet stops, constitutional rights become completely optional.

​This is the type of behavior that give law enforcement officers a bad rap in our country. These are planned out and executed violations of our rights.

text:
10 things you probably didn’t know about Mario Paint (1992, SNES)

​1. The Iconic Box Art Artist

While Shigeru Miyamoto and his core team directed the game's playful tone, the whimsical, vibrant packaging illustration was created by veteran Nintendo artist and designer Yoichi Kotabe (famed for solidifying the classic 2D look of Mario and Princess Peach) alongside character designer Shigefumi Hino. Kotabe’s lively brushwork perfectly captured the leap from gaming into desktop creativity.

​2. The Hardware Behind the Bundle

Mario Paint was the title specifically engineered to sell and ship with the Super NES Mouse (model SNS-016) and an official hard plastic mousepad. It remains one of the few console pack-ins designed almost exclusively around a non-traditional pointer peripheral.

​3. Birthplace of the "Totakeke" / K.K. Slider Theme

Long before Animal Crossing existed, legendary composer Kazumi Totaka snuck his signature 19-note musical Easter egg into the game. If you click the letter "O" in the title screen, Totaka's Song plays while an animated icon dances across the canvas.

​4. The Undying Legacy of the Music Composer

The built-in music sequencer only allowed three simultaneous notes and a handful of quirky instrument sounds (like dog barks, car horns, and Yoshi grunts), but it spawned an entire subculture. Decades later, that exact three-track limitation directly inspired modern standalone software like Mario Paint Composer.

​5. "Gnat Attack" Was Developed in Just a Few Days

The fast-paced minigame Gnat Attack (Coffee Break), where players swat buzzing flies and dodge dragonfly stingers, was programmed by Hirofumi Matsuoka in a single weekend. It proved so addictive that the team nearly gave it equal prominence to the drawing tools.

​6. The Studio Behind It Wasn’t Just Nintendo

While published by Nintendo, a significant portion of Mario Paint was co-developed by Intelligent Systems, the studio best known for tactical RPGs like Fire Emblem and Wars (Advance Wars).

​7. Eraser Easter Eggs

Clearing your canvas wasn’t just a simple blank screen. Clicking the bomb icon triggered playful destructive animations—ranging from a digital steamroller flattening the canvas to rocket ships blasting off and tearing away the pixels layer by layer.

​8. Direct Ancestor of Super Mario Maker

Nintendo’s internal development teams used modified, mouse-driven track-building and asset-placement tools inspired by Mario Paint to design levels for titles like Super Mario World. Decades later, Takashi Tezuka confirmed that the UI and stamp philosophy directly informed the creation of Super Mario Maker.

​9. Pre-Rendered 3D Icons Ahead of Donkey Kong Country

Some of the stamping tools and UI cursors experimented with early pre-rendered Silicon Graphics-style 3D sprites well before Rare popularized the technique on the SNES with Donkey Kong Country in 1994.

​10. Custom Animation Capabilities on a 16-Bit Cartridge

Despite the storage limits of a 1992 SNES cartridge, Mario Paint featured a functional 4-to-9 frame looping animation suite, complete with customizable animation paths across pre-rendered backgrounds.

​Which feature did you spend the most hours on back in the day: composing custom chiptunes, swatting gnats, or drawing pixel art frame-by-frame? Let us know below! 👇🎮🎨

The Unseen Activities of the Knowing Principle -

At the philosophical centre of Dr. Abercrombie's Inquiries lies an arresting truth concerning the origin of human certainty: how does an intellectual being establish the existence, constancy, and causal (both Natural to Supernatural) relations of things when the operative principles connecting those things remain concealed from direct observation?

The question is developed through an exceptional series of investigations involving the nature of matter, the continuity of personal identity, the formation of memory, the apparent independence of consciousness, extraordinary perceptual conditions, testimony concerning miraculous events, and the obscure relation between cerebral organization and intellectual activity. 

These investigations culminate in an exacting examination of scientific knowledge itself, particularly the physician's difficulty in distinguishing apparent causes from actual causes.

Abercrombie commences with a proposition of substantial metaphysical consequence. 

The human understanding apprehends the properties and operations of matter without penetrating the ultimate constitution of the powers by which those operations are accomplished. 

The transfer of motion, the attraction of gravitating bodies, the production of chemical effects, and the particular activities of medicinal substances are familiar through their manifestations, while their underlying efficient agencies remain beyond immediate inspection.

Physical science therefore proceeds through the determination of established relations. This epistemological avenues open an extensive philosophical inquiry into the nature of power, the intelligibility of created order, and the distinction between observed succession and efficient agency.

The Creator's establishment of natural order is explicitly affirmed in the opening exposition, providing the metaphysical setting within which Abercrombie considers both physical regularity and exceptional divine intervention.

The second and more remarkable movement transfers this investigation from external nature into the interior constitution of the thinking subject. Sensation requires bodily organs and appropriate external conditions, yet memory may recall what no longer exists, imagination may combine impressions in circumstances wholly removed from the original objects, and the understanding may contemplate remote celestial systems without occupying the places or physically encountering the objects under consideration.

Abercrombie advances these phenomena as considerations bearing upon the distinct existence of mind and it's survival beyond the dissolution of the corporeal frame. 

His discussion of the persistence of personal identity amid bodily change is particularly significant because it locates the continuity of the person in the subject who remembers, reasons, and recognizes himself throughout successive alterations of his material constitution.

The clinical investigations carry this reasoning into regions of unusual intellectual manifestation. Disease sometimes interrupts the formation of new memories while leaving older impressions intact; under different circumstances, long-forgotten acquisitions return with startling precision.

Certain patients retain knowledge of persons without retaining their names; others preserve practical performance during apparent suspension of ordinary awareness. In states historically described as double consciousness, different periods of experience may become accessible only during corresponding states of the individual's mental condition.

These observations have complex relationship between intellectual possession, voluntary recollection, conscious recognition, and outward expression. 

Abercrombie's examples offer an unusually rich historical record for examining whether the apparent disappearance of an intellectual capacity necessarily entails its destruction.

Dreams, somnambulism, hallucinations,(that are real as real to the patient) and spectral sights furnish a further series of investigations. 

The essential phenomenon concerns the power of an internally generated perception to acquire the force of an external reality.

A visible figure may appear before a person who remains rational and recognizes its phantasmal character; another individual may perform elaborate actions during somnambulism and afterward possess no ordinary recollection of the performance.

Abercrombie's accounts of extraordinary language recollection, musical execution, vivid spectral appearances, and alternating memory states enlarge his inquiry into the structure of conscious experience. The physician here confronts a striking separation between the occurrence of an intellectual operation and the subject's subsequent knowledge that it occurred.

The treatise also develops a substantial philosophical defence of testimony. Its distinction between the marvellous and the miraculous is essential. 

The marvellous concerns events beyond ordinary acquaintance; the miraculous concerns events that depart from the established natural sequence through the intervention of an agent capable of producing such a departure.
Abercrombie connects this distinction to revelation, divine omnipotence, the credibility of witnesses, and the historical continuity afforded by religious commemorative observances. His argument deserves particular examination because he constructs a theory of evidence in which the character of witnesses, their independent agreement, the nature of the event, and the established purposes of divine revelation contribute to the grounds of belief.

The final sections return to medical investigation. Here Abercrombie examines the uncertainties of classifying diseases, the dangers of false induction, the inadequacy of observations selected to support a preconceived theory, and the difficulty of attributing recovery to a particular remedy when other circumstances have changed.

The larger philosophical achievement is a systematic account of the discipline required to investigate causes when their complete operative structure cannot be directly apprehended.

The resulting work furnishes an extensive historical foundation for research into consciousness, noetic continuity, causal metaphysics, extraordinary perception, philosophical theology, mnemonic transmission, and the reliability of scientific inference.

text:
Tuomas Iisalo says Cedric Coward’s rare versatility gives him the best on/off impact for the Grizzlies.

Tuomas Iisalo: “Well, it’s been very apparent when you look at the on-offs in our team, I think he’s leading the whole team, and not just in the on-offs, but also the expected ones that adjust for his shot quality. And he’s just developed into a very balanced player on both ends. … But what I like about Cedric is that he’s able to, like you said, go into many, many different roles. He can be a screener, he can be a handler, he’s terrific in transition, pushing it up or sprinting the wing for open threes, has been rebounding the ball tremendously well, and like you said, defensively, the weak side rim protection that he offers at the position, too, is probably the best in the league for anyone. And then the rebounding has also been extremely high level, and those are very rare qualities for a two guard to possess.”

Memphis is +16.4 in net rating with Coward on the floor and −0.6 with him off, a +17.0 swing that leads all Grizzlies regulars.

text:
🇨🇳 五国：家里有人不吃某种食物，聚餐时大家会重新安排的细节 TOP10
🇯🇵 5か国：家族に食べないものがあるとき、食事会で見直すこと TOP10
🇰🇷 5개국: 가족 중 못 먹거나 안 먹는 음식이 있을 때 모임에서 다시 챙기는 것 TOP10
🇻🇳 5 quốc gia: 10 chi tiết cả nhà sắp xếp lại khi có người không ăn một món hay nguyên liệu nào đó
🇺🇸 Five Countries: 10 Details Families Rethink When Someone at the Table Avoids a Food
🇨🇳 中国
家里说好吃火锅。菜还没买，就有人在群里问了一句：“今晚那个汤底，大家都能吃吗？”
1）先问避开什么 | 何を避けるか先に聞く | 무엇을 피하는지 먼저 묻기 | Hỏi trước cần tránh gì | Ask what needs to be avoided
“不吃海鲜”可能指好几种情况。买菜前私下问清楚哪些食材、汤底或调味料要避开。
2）汤底单独成锅 | だしを別鍋にする | 육수를 별도 냄비에 준비하기 | Dùng nồi nước dùng riêng | Serve the broth in a separate pot
有人不吃肉，就给蔬菜另备一锅合适的汤底。需要避开交叉接触时，不能只指望同一口锅中间的隔板。
3）下锅前分出一盘 | 鍋に入れる前に一皿取り分ける | 냄비에 넣기 전에 한 접시 덜어 두기 | Dành riêng một đĩa trước khi nhúng | Set aside a plate before cooking
别等大家夹过一轮再把菜端走。备菜时就分出那一份，也好记得每盘放了什么。

4）生料夹和捞菜勺分开 | 生の具材用と取り分け用の道具を分ける | 생재료 집게와 건지는 국자를 구분하기 | Tách kẹp gắp đồ sống và muôi vớt | Separate raw-food tongs and serving ladles
涮肉的夹子不去夹熟菜。两锅各有自己的勺，吃到一半也不用临时找一把共用。
5）锅底和蘸料都看配料 | だしとつけだれの原材料を確認する | 육수와 찍어 먹는 소스의 원재료 확인 | Kiểm tra thành phần nước lẩu và nước chấm | Check broth and dipping-sauce ingredients
一小包现成底料也可能含有要避开的食材。留着包装，临上桌换了牌子就重新看一眼。

6）小料摆在旁边 | 薬味を別添えにする | 양념은 옆에 따로 내기 | Để gia vị thêm bên cạnh | Serve toppings on the side
葱、香菜和辣椒各装一碟，让每个人到自己碗里再加。家里习惯出锅就撒的那一步，可以留到各自碗里。
7）让那一份也能当正餐 | 代わりの一皿も一食分にする | 대체 메뉴도 한 끼가 되게 준비하기 | Chuẩn bị phần thay thế đủ thành bữa | Make the alternative a full meal
免了一盘肉，不必让对方只吃几片青菜。把适合的主食和能吃饱的菜一起安排进去。
8）换菜时告诉做饭的人 | 具材を変えたら調理する人に伝える | 재료를 바꿨다면 요리하는 사람에게 알리기 | Báo người nấu khi đổi nguyên liệu | Tell the cook when an ingredient changes
群里说定的底料卖完了，有人临时买了新款。到厨房先把这个变化交代清楚。
9）外带也标清是哪一份 | 持ち帰り分にも目印を付ける | 포장에도 어느 몫인지 표시하기 | Đánh dấu từng phần mang về | Label portions to take home
两盒菜外观看着一样，收拾到最后很容易拿反。装好就写上是哪道菜、哪一份。
10）端上桌后别劝尝 | 食卓で無理に味見を勧めない | 식탁에서 맛보라고 권하지 않기 | Không ép nếm khi đã lên bàn | Skip the pressure to try a bite
有人说“我吃这锅就好”，就把菜递过去接着聊天。大家不用轮流问他为什么。
如果今晚家里吃火锅，你会先把锅底的配料发到群里，还是先问大家哪些调料也要避开？
如果涉及食物过敏，提前与当事人确认如何避免交叉接触。无法确认配料或用具接触情况的菜，不要给对方食用。

🇯🇵 日本
家族の食事会でコースを予約する。苦手な食材は伝えたつもりでも、だし、小鉢、最後のデザートまで話が通っているかは別の確認になる。

1）予約前に店へ確認 | 订位前先问餐厅 | 예약 전에 식당에 확인하기 | Hỏi quán trước khi đặt chỗ | Check with the restaurant before booking
席を押さえる前に、どの食材を避ける必要があり、どこまで対応できるかを聞く。
2）だしの材料 | 高汤原料 | 육수 재료 | Thành phần nước dùng | Broth ingredients
具を取り替えても、汁に使うだしは同じかもしれない。食べないものが入っていないか、汁も含めて聞く。
3）小鉢やつけだれ | 小菜与蘸汁 | 곁들임과 찍어 먹는 소스 | Món phụ và nước chấm | Side dishes and dipping sauces
主菜だけ変えてもらって安心しがち。添え物とたれまで確認しておくと、食べられる皿が分かる。
4）コース全体の差し替え | 套餐全程替换安排 | 코스 전체의 대체 메뉴 | Món thay thế trong cả thực đơn | Substitutions across the whole course
前菜は変えられても、ほかの皿は難しいことがある。頼む前に、どの皿がどうなるか一皿ずつ確認する。
5）子どもの取り分け | 给孩子分餐 | 아이 몫 따로 덜기 | Chia phần riêng cho trẻ | Portioning food for children
大人の皿から分けるつもりなら、その皿も先に確認する。見た目が似ている別の小鉢と混ぜないようにする。
6）同じ厨房での調理 | 共用厨房的制作安排 | 같은 주방에서의 조리 | Chế biến trong bếp dùng chung | Shared-kitchen preparation
アレルギーの場合は、同じ油や器具を使うかも店に聞く。店が分からないことまで大丈夫だと思い込まない。

7）別の皿が誰に届くか | 确认替换菜送给谁 | 대체 요리가 갈 사람 확인하기 | Xác định món riêng được đưa cho ai | Get the alternate plate to the right person
予約した人が席を外すこともある。店と確認した料理が誰の席に届くか、出てきたときにも確かめる。
8）食べられるデザート | 能吃的甜点 | 먹을 수 있는 디저트 | Món tráng miệng dùng được | A dessert everyone can take part in
誕生日なら、最後の一皿も大事。ケーキが合わない人の分も、乾杯の前に手配しておく。
9）急なメニュー変更 | 临时菜单变动 | 갑작스러운 메뉴 변경 | Đổi món vào phút chót | Last-minute menu changes
当日になって仕入れの都合で料理が変わったら、前の回答をそのまま当てはめず、新しい料理で確認する。
10）本人が選べる店を選ぶ | 选让当事人也能点菜的餐厅 | 당사자도 고를 수 있는 식당 정하기 | Chọn quán để người có kiêng kỵ cũng được chọn món | Choose a restaurant where everyone has options
候補を二つくらい出し、本人にもメニューを見てもらう。予約係だけで一皿に決めてしまうより、当日を楽しみにしやすい。
家族の食事会を予約するとき、最初に確認するのはだし、調理器具、デザートのどれですか？
食物アレルギーがある場合は、原材料と調理中の接触についてお店に確認し、確認できない料理は避けてください。

🇰🇷 대한민국
가족이 모여 반찬을 한가운데 놓는다. 한 사람은 매운 음식을 먹지 않고, 다른 사람은 고기를 피한다. 같은 상에 앉아도 각자 고를 수 있게 놓는 순서가 달라진다.
1）양념하기 전에 덜어 두기 | 调味前先分出一份 | 味つけ前に取り分ける | Múc riêng trước khi nêm | Set a portion aside before seasoning
나물 한 가지를 무칠 때 매운 양념을 넣기 전에 덜어 둔다. 상에 낼 때는 같은 쟁반에 두 가지 맛을 함께 올릴 수도 있다.

2）국물의 재료 먼저 알리기 | 先说清汤底原料 | 汁物の材料を先に伝える | Nói trước nguyên liệu trong nước dùng | Say what went into the broth
국에 고기 건더기가 없어도 육수에 고기나 멸치가 들어갔을 수 있다. 끓인 사람이 국물 재료를 알려 주면 각자 고르기 쉽다.
3）김치에 들어간 양념 확인 | 确认泡菜调料 | キムチの調味料を確認する | Kiểm tra gia vị trong kimchi | Check kimchi seasonings
집에서 담갔거나 사 온 김치가 어떤 재료로 만들어졌는지 확인한다. 채소 반찬이라고만 말하면 액젓 같은 재료는 전해지지 않는다.
4）비빔밥은 각자 그릇에서 | 拌饭留在各自碗里拌 | ビビンバは各自の器で混ぜる | Trộn cơm trong bát riêng | Let everyone mix their own rice bowl
밥과 채소, 고기, 양념을 따로 올려 둔다. 비비는 마지막 한 동작을 각자 하면 원하는 조합을 고르기 쉽다.
5）쌈장과 고명은 옆에 | 蘸酱与点缀另外放 | つけみそと薬味は別添え | Để riêng tương chấm và đồ rắc | Put sauces and garnishes on the side
고명은 마지막에 올리고, 쌈장은 작은 종지에 담는다. 어른이 한 사람씩 미리 얹어 줄 필요가 없다.
6）반찬마다 덜어 먹는 도구 놓기 | 每盘小菜各放分菜用具 | おかずごとに取り分け用の道具を置く | Đặt dụng cụ gắp riêng cho từng món | Give each side dish its own serving utensil
두 접시를 한 집게로 오가면 어떤 양념이 묻었는지 놓치기 쉽다. 접시마다 도구를 두고 그 자리에 다시 놓는다.
7）한 끼가 되는 반찬 구성 | 凑得成一餐的配菜组合 | 一食になるおかずの組み合わせ | Xếp món phụ đủ thành một bữa | Offer sides that make a full meal
못 먹는 반찬이 여러 개라면 밥만 남을 수 있다. 먹을 수 있는 국과 반찬도 처음부터 함께 준비한다.

8）굽는 자리와 나오는 접시 나누기 | 分开烤制位置与出菜盘 | 焼く場所と盛り皿を分ける | Tách chỗ nướng và đĩa đựng | Separate grill space and serving plates
고기와 채소를 따로 먹기로 했다면, 어디서 굽고 어느 접시에 담을지 굽기 전에 정한다.
9）남은 반찬은 담기 전에 확인 | 打包剩菜前先确认 | 残ったおかずは詰める前に確認する | Hỏi trước khi đóng phần đồ ăn còn lại | Check before packing leftovers
집에 가져가라고 여러 반찬을 한 통에 넣기 전에, 상대가 어떤 접시를 원했는지 한 번 묻는다.
10）못 먹는 이유를 대신 말하지 않기 | 不替别人解释忌口原因 | 食べない理由を代わりに説明しない | Không giải thích thay lý do người khác kiêng | Let people explain their own dietary choices
먹을 수 있는 접시를 알려 주는 것으로 충분할 때가 많다. 이유를 설명할지는 본인이 정한다.
가족 모두가 같은 상에서 비빔밥을 먹는다면, 어떤 재료를 꼭 따로 담아 두고 싶어요?

🇻🇳 Việt Nam
Một người ăn chay đến ăn cơm nhà. Mâm đã có rau và đậu hũ, nhưng trước khi dọn vẫn cần hỏi nước mắm ở đâu, món kho dùng nước gì và ai đang cầm đôi đũa gắp.
1）Hỏi cụ thể ăn chay theo cách nào | 问清具体吃素方式 | どの食材を避ける菜食か聞く | 어떤 방식으로 채식하는지 묻기 | Ask what vegetarian means for this guest
Có người ăn được trứng hoặc sữa, có người tránh cả hai. Hỏi trước bữa ăn để chuẩn bị đúng phần họ dùng được.
2）Rau luộc để nước chấm riêng | 白煮菜与蘸料分开 | ゆで野菜とつけだれを分ける | 데친 채소와 찍어 먹는 소스 분리 | Serve dipping sauce separately from vegetables
Đĩa rau giữ nguyên, còn nước chấm để trong chén riêng. Ai dùng loại nào thì tự chọn khi ăn.

3）Nồi canh riêng từ đầu | 从一开始另做一锅汤 | 最初から別鍋で汁物を作る | 처음부터 국을 따로 끓이기 | Start a separate soup from scratch
Nồi canh đã nấu với thịt thì vớt thịt ra vẫn còn nước dùng ấy. Nếu cần canh chay, chuẩn bị nồi riêng ngay lúc bắt đầu.
4）Xem thành phần của gia vị mua sẵn | 查现成调味料配料 | 市販調味料の原材料を見る | 시판 양념의 원재료 확인 | Check packaged seasonings
Gói nêm hoặc nước sốt có thể chứa nguyên liệu khác với thứ người nấu nghĩ tới. Đọc nhãn trước khi cho vào nồi.
5）Món đậu đủ ăn cùng cơm | 准备能配饭吃饱的豆制品 | ごはんと食べられる豆腐のおかず | 밥과 함께 먹을 만한 두부 반찬 | A tofu dish substantial enough for dinner
Thêm một món đậu hũ hoặc món đậu phù hợp để người ăn chay có một phần cơm trọn bữa, thay vì phải ăn quanh những món còn lại.
6）Chừa phần trước khi rắc topping | 撒配料前预留一份 | トッピングをのせる前に取り分ける | 고명을 올리기 전에 덜어 두기 | Set aside a portion before adding toppings
Có món chỉ tới lúc dọn mới rắc thêm một thứ người kia không ăn. Chừa phần riêng trước bước đó sẽ dễ hơn gỡ ra lúc đã bày lên bàn.
7）Dùng chén đũa gắp riêng | 使用独立分菜碗筷 | 取り分け用の器と箸を分ける | 덜어 먹는 그릇과 젓가락을 따로 두기 | Use separate serving dishes and chopsticks
Đặt đôi đũa gắp ngay cạnh món chay và nhắc cả nhà dùng đúng đôi đó. Chỗ đặt rõ ràng thì khách cũng dễ tự lấy.
8）Nói ai mang món gì trước buổi gặp | 聚餐前说清谁带什么菜 | 集まる前に持ち寄る料理を確認する | 모이기 전에 누가 뭘 가져오는지 확인하기 | Coordinate who brings each dish
Nếu mỗi nhà mang một món, nhắn cả tên món lẫn thành phần cần lưu ý. Tránh tới giờ ăn mới thấy mâm có nhiều đĩa nhưng thiếu món cho một người.

9）Đặt phần riêng ở chỗ dễ với | 把单独份放在好夹的位置 | 別の一皿を手が届く場所に置く | 따로 준비한 음식을 손 닿는 곳에 놓기 | Put the separate dish within easy reach
Món dùng được để ngay gần người cần chọn. Họ có thể tự gắp thêm mà không phải nhờ chuyền qua cả mâm.
10）Hỏi thêm một câu trước khi múc | 盛菜前先问一句 | よそう前に一言聞く | 덜어 주기 전에 한마디 묻기 | Ask before serving someone
Có thể mời “Bạn dùng món này không?” rồi để họ tự quyết. Gắp sẵn vào bát đôi khi làm người được mời khó từ chối.
Nếu có người ăn chay đến ăn cơm nhà, món nào bạn muốn nấu sao cho cả bàn cùng gắp được?

🇺🇸 United States
At a family potluck, everyone shows up with a dish. The host arranged for an alternative, but somebody just moved the serving spoon from one tray to the next.
1）Check with the guest before planning | 排菜单前先问当事人 | 献立を決める前に本人に聞く | 메뉴 정하기 전에 당사자에게 묻기 | Hỏi người dự trước khi lên thực đơn
A guest might be avoiding a food by choice or because of an allergy. Ask privately what needs to be kept out and whether shared equipment is a concern.
2）Put the ingredient list beside each dish | 每道菜旁放配料表 | 料理ごとに原材料を添える | 음식마다 재료 목록 놓기 | Đặt danh sách thành phần cạnh từng món
“Grandma’s casserole” tells the family whose recipe it is. A short ingredient card tells the person deciding whether to take a serving what went into it.
3）Keep the packaging for prepared ingredients | 留下半成品配料的包装 | 加工食材の包装を取っておく | 가공 재료의 포장 남겨 두기 | Giữ bao bì của nguyên liệu chế biến sẵn
A marinade or boxed mix may have ingredients you don’t remember. Keep the label available in case someone needs to check it.

4）Give each tray its own serving spoon | 每个餐盘配专用勺 | トレーごとに取り分け用のスプーンを置く | 음식 쟁반마다 전용 스푼 놓기 | Mỗi khay có muôi riêng
The spoon belongs with its dish. If two dishes look alike, label the utensils as well as the trays.
5）Set aside the planned plate before the buffet opens | 自助开餐前留出单独餐盘 | ビュッフェ開始前に一皿を別にする | 뷔페 시작 전에 한 접시 따로 챙기기 | Dành phần riêng trước khi mở bàn tự chọn
If you’ve agreed on a separate meal, plate and cover it before everyone starts serving themselves. The person it’s for knows which plate to look for.
6）Check the grill and the fryer | 确认烤架与炸锅是否共用 | グリルと揚げ油の共用を確認する | 그릴과 튀김기 공용 여부 확인하기 | Kiểm tra vỉ nướng và nồi chiên có dùng chung không
A food can pick up traces from a shared grill, utensil, or frying oil. If that matters for the guest, account for it before the first batch goes on.
7）Update the card when the recipe changes | 配方变动时更新配料卡 | レシピ変更時に表示も直す | 조리법을 바꾸면 재료표도 고치기 | Cập nhật thẻ khi đổi công thức
The store was out of the usual dressing, so someone brought a different brand. The card should describe what actually went into the dish.
8）Plan dessert as well as dinner | 甜点也一起安排 | 夕食と一緒にデザートも考える | 식사와 함께 디저트도 준비하기 | Tính cả món tráng miệng
If there’s cake for a birthday, ask what the guest would enjoy during that part of the meal. Give them a reason to stay for the candles.
9）Let people serve themselves | 让每个人自己选菜 | 各自が食べるものを選べるようにする | 각자 먹을 것을 고르게 하기 | Để mỗi người tự chọn món
Start by showing people where the ingredients are listed. Let them decide what goes on their plates, without having to explain their choice.

10）Leave room for a guest to bring their own food | 给自带餐食留位置 | 持参した食事を置ける場所を用意する | 가져온 음식을 먹을 자리 마련하기 | Chừa chỗ cho khách mang đồ ăn riêng
Some guests will be most comfortable bringing their own meal. Give them a place to keep it and a seat at the same table.
If you were hosting a potluck, what would you want everyone to send you before they showed up with a dish?
For a food allergy, check ingredients and cross-contact with the person affected. Picking an ingredient off a finished dish doesn’t make it suitable for them.

NEWCASTLE ⚫️ vs ARSENAL 🔴 MD11

⚫️ Newcastle Attack

Under Eddie Howe, Newcastle primarily used their right side / Arsenal's left side as the attacking starting point.

As part of their approach against Arsenal, they delivered long balls to the right flank, positioned key players there, and looked for mid-range shots from between the lines.

At the time, Gordon was deployed as the right winger against Arsenal, while Isak, operating as a false 9, drifted toward the right side.

Half-Spaces ⚫️

Create numerical superiority on the flanks.

Exploit the far-side half-space / back-post area, creating 1v1 situations against the opposition SB from the defender's blind side.

Inverting SB / CB ⚫️

New signing A. Dedić operates at right-back.

Hall plays at left-back.
In England's match against the Czech Republic, Hall formed a left-sided unit with Eze and MLS.

T. Livramento missed the early part of the season through injury but returned to the squad against Fulham.
In last season's home meeting with Arsenal, he was substituted due to injury.

SBs support the wingers through movements into the half-spaces and overlapping runs.
Burn has also played as an SB/WB, including in last season's direct meeting and against Leeds in 2025-26.
When Newcastle need a goal, Burn joins the attack inside the box.

DLP / GK ⚫️

Bruno Guimarães has left the club.
Newcastle have brought in Nico González, S. Steur from Ajax, and A. Bamba from AS Monaco.
One pivot drops into the back line.
The other pivot takes up a vertically staggered position and becomes the fifth or sixth attacker.

The midfielder dropping deeper creates a numerical advantage (+1) against the opposition's first presser during build-up.

This secures rest defence.
It also acts as the trigger for an SB or CB to invert.

False Winger ⚫️

A. Gordon has moved to Barcelona.
Barnes, Elanga, and Murphy cut inside to carry the ball, dribble, and shoot.
Elanga has returned from injury.
His appearances have been limited to shorter spells, including substitute appearances.
He was called up to the Sweden national team.
Against Bosnia and Herzegovina, he assisted the opening goal.
Elanga also scored with a left-footed mid-range shot against Japan at the World Cup.

Murphy has scored from mid-range in direct meetings and, more recently, against Fulham.

New signing B. Touré has been receiving opportunities as a substitute.

Cross-Field Passes / Long Balls / Switch Passes / Kick-Off Balls ⚫️

Cross-field passes: Direct passes toward the opposite flank.
Long balls: Direct passes played along a more vertical route.

Switch passes: For this analysis, defined as moving the ball from one flank to the other through several short- or medium-range passes.

Asymmetrical Attack Against Arsenal ⚫️

① Long balls are directed toward the left side.
② However, with Saliba's return, the false 9 may instead compete aerially against a pivot or SB.

① Long-ball approach against Arsenal
From the GK and other deeper positions, Newcastle's #9 drifts toward the left flank (Arsenal's right side) to establish an attacking starting point.

The intention is to avoid Gabriel and Calafiori and instead target the side defended by Ben White / Timber and Konsa.

Gabriel and Calafiori are also target men in Arsenal's set-piece routines.
The hypothesis is that Newcastle are trying to improve their aerial-duel success rate by avoiding those players.

During build-up and counterattacks, attackers drift toward the right side, targeting the space behind an inverting SB.

Another hypothesis is that Osula's right-footedness contributes to the decision to use the left side.
From there, he can collect loose balls, cut inside, and shoot more naturally.

Slavia Prague and Hull City also directed long balls toward Arsenal's right side.
Konsa was frequently required to deal with these situations.

② SB inversion

Cross-field passes.
Support the winger and recover second balls.
Challenge the opposition RSB and winger in aerial duels rather than targeting the CB directly, aiming to improve the aerial-duel win rate.

🔴 Pseudo Back Five

Recovery 🔴

CBs and the DLP play central roles in recovering defensively against counterattacks.

Pivot Drops into the Back Line 🔴

The #9/#10 drops back into the pivot area to help maintain compact vertical distances between the CB, MF, and FW lines.
Against Liverpool, Ødegaard and Havertz tracked back as far as the defensive line, allowing the SBs to maintain double teams.

Their defensive involvement should therefore vary according to the game state.

🔴 SET-PIECE DEFENCE

Defensive Approach 🔴

A Mix of M2M + Zonal Marking

M2M 🔴

Near-Post Stone 🔴

The near-post stone prevents the opposition from making first contact.

Defending Short Routines 🔴

As short routines often develop through the half-space or pocket, Arsenal must keep the central lane compact defensively.

The PNP San Joaquin Municipal Police Station defended its monitoring of agricultural areas ahead of El Niño after drawing criticism over its officers’ apparent inspection of rice fields, but its explanation offered few details about what the activity actually accomplished.

In a Facebook statement posted on Nov. 15, the police station acknowledged concerns raised online over its earlier post showing uniformed personnel observing crops on a hilly area beside a road.

The original Nov. 13 post described the activity as an inspection and monitoring of rice fields and other vulnerable areas to assess the potential effects of prolonged dry conditions, identify water scarcity concerns, and coordinate preventive measures with concerned agencies.

The photos, however, showed officers standing beside the crops, prompting commenters to question whether police personnel were qualified to assess agricultural conditions and whether the activity should have been handled by the Department of Agriculture (DA) or the municipal agriculture office.

In its response, the station clarified that technical agricultural assessments and assistance to farmers fall primarily under the DA and the Municipal Agriculture Office, while the PNP is expected only to provide support for disaster preparedness and public safety.

It said its personnel were monitoring vulnerable communities, identifying possible public safety concerns arising from prolonged dry conditions and water scarcity, and coordinating with government agencies and the local government unit.

However, the statement did not identify the specific areas assessed, the conditions observed by the officers, or any public safety risks they found during the activity.

It also did not provide details of any consultations with agricultural authorities, the actual findings from the monitoring, or concrete recommendations and follow-up measures resulting from the inspection.

Instead, much of the response relied on general assurances about inter-agency coordination, community preparedness, transparency, and the PNP’s commitment to public safety.

The station described its activity as part of a whole-of-government approach and said it had no intention of replacing or duplicating the technical functions of agricultural authorities.

While the clarification explains why police personnel may take part in disaster preparedness activities, it still leaves a basic question unanswered: what exactly did they contribute to the monitoring of agricultural areas?

The station ended its statement by reiterating its commitment to “responsive, trusted, and transformative policing” for the municipality.

(✍🏻: John Lloyd Aleta)

text:
A young Hopi Indian maiden from the village of Oraibi, on the Hopi Reservation in Arizona, around 1901...

She wears her hair in traditional squash blossom whorls (or quavaho), large side-buns that symbolize the squash blossom and represent the flower of the plant and fertility. Unmarried young Hopi women traditionally wore this style. This iconic style is widely noted as the inspiration for the hairstyle worn by Princess Leia in Star Wars.

. . . 

Traditional Hopi women's hair tells a deep story of life stages, fertility, and cultural identity. The most famous Hopi hairstyle is the squash blossom (or butterfly whorl), which has a rich history tied to tradition, coming-of-age ceremonies, and popular culture.

Children traditionally wore their hair in small round balls or simple bobs on the sides of their heads. Once a Hopi girl reached puberty and completed her traditional coming-of-age initiation ceremony, she was allowed to wear the iconic squash blossom hairstyle. A female relative (such as an aunt or grandmother) wraps the hair around a U-shaped wooden bow or a curved piece of willow/cedar to shape two large, circular whorls on either side of the head, representing butterfly wings or a blooming squash flower. The style symbolizes fertility, abundance, readiness for marriage, and a close spiritual connection to the Hopi agricultural way of life (corn, beans, and squash). After marriage, the hair style changes; women typically transition to wearing their hair in traditional hanging side braids or ponytails.

The right to wear the squash blossom is earned through a rigorous multi-day rite of passage. During this ceremony, the young woman grinds corn for her paternal family, offers prayers to the rising sun, and learns to prepare traditional foods like piki bread. Her hair is washed with root extracts (such as yucca root) and styled in the intricate whorls using specialized wooden or cedar tools and ties.

The squash blossom hairstyle gained global fame as the visual inspiration for Princess Leia Organa’s iconic "cinnamon bun" hair in the original 1977 Star Wars film. While creator George Lucas initially referenced early-20th-century Mexican revolutionary soldaderas, film historians and design collections point directly to historic photographs of unmarried Hopi women from the late 19th and early 20th centuries as the true template for the twin side-buns.

For weeks, the impeachment of Pete Hegseth was a story. PBS NewsHour previewed it the night Congress came back. Washington Week ran a segment in October asking whether Congress would impeach him and how Trump would react. Hakeem Jeffries said he was a “hard yes.” He promised Democrats would “run Pete Hegseth out of town.”

One week after the midterms, Democrats got their chance.

On Tuesday, November 10, Republicans moved to kill the impeachment by sending Thomas Massie’s eight articles to the Republican-run Judiciary Committee, where they would die for the rest of this Congress. The House agreed, 211 to 204.

Eleven Democrats did not vote:

•Julia Brownley (California)
•Lou Correa (California)
•Laura Gillen (New York)
•Steven Horsford (Nevada)
•Jonathan Jackson (Illinois)
•Nancy Pelosi (California)
•Brittany Pettersen (Colorado)
•Melanie Stansbury (New Mexico)
•Haley Stevens (Michigan)
•Marilyn Strickland (Washington)
•Frederica Wilson (Florida)

They lost by seven votes. Eleven didn’t show up. By House rules, a tie was all they needed for the impeachment to go forward.

Some of the missing Democrats were at a reception held by Elect Democratic Women, a political action committee. One of its founders is Katherine Clark, the House Democratic whip. The whip’s job is to get members to the floor when a vote matters.

The vote was set for 5:30. The reception ran from 4:30 to 6:30.

Nobody heads to the airport for an important flight planning to arrive five minutes before the gate closes. You leave early, because missing it isn’t an option. For a vote you campaigned on, you’re in the building well before it starts.

Their schedules show which one they couldn’t afford to miss.

A few offered a personal reason and left it there: a personal emergency, a medical procedure, no details. I don’t believe it, and I don’t have to. These are elected officials who missed a vote they campaigned on. Private citizens are entitled to privacy. Public officials who want to be believed have to say what happened.

A medical procedure explains where someone was. It doesn’t explain why it had to be that day. Nobody asked.

Rep. Sydney Kamlager-Dove, a California Democrat, put it plainly: “We knew that this vote was coming, so people should have gotten their raggedy selves up these steps to vote.”

text:
We have new hats!
Now that I have your attention, I want to share my submission to the enquiry into the NSW Firearm Reforms. Hopefully, it can inspire you if you are unsure what to write.
My concerns surrounding New South Wales firearm reforms are something that I think about nearly all day. I work at my family's gun shop in Gympie, QLD. My Dad started this business 52 years ago in Victoria. I grew up in this shop and the industry. I know my customers like family.
Every day, we are here educating people in legislation, firearm maintenance and vermin control. We do everything in our power to abide by all the rules and our customers are good people trying to do the same.
These laws have made law-abiding firearm owners look like the problem. Bondi was caused by men who should not have had firearm licences. The man's son was on a terrorist watchlist; the red flags were endless. I find this incredibly shocking because in QLD at least, when someone dies, the family gets a knock on the door asking for the firearms before the body has gone cold. We have people bringing their guns in for storage regularly because a family member with a conviction has moved in, and they can't hold their guns because of association. How did such a major mistake happen in NSW licensing, and why is it that licensed firearm owners are the problem?
My concern is that you don't understand the impact these reforms have on firearm owners. My best friend grew up on a farm. Her Dad was diagnosed with Alzheimer's, so she had to get all his 12 firearms transferred into her name, on top of the 2 firearms she already owned. She lives in the city and has 14 guns in a safe, and she basically only takes them out to clean them. Why should she have to choose which of her guns to keep? She will always protect those guns and never hurt anyone.
Then there are the many customers of mine who have safes full of guns because there are different tools for different jobs. Different-sized creatures need a different size of bullet to be HUMANELY euthanised, and not 1 gun can do this. When the size of pests ranges from mice to buffalo, there is a firearm for everything. Then you also need to factor in the land: are you hunting in hills and scrub or long flats? Different calibres offer different ranges, and you don’t use the same calibre to hunt pigs in hills and scrub (where it will be close range) as you do in long flat country, where you need something with more reach. These are just a few examples of why 1 person would need multiple guns for pest control and hunting; there is plenty more to elaborate and give more reasons for more firearms.
The people most likely hurting the most, though, are the firearm dealers. Businesses like mine have been family-run for decades. The permits didn’t come in for months; the reclassification has left the shops with customers cancelling orders and leaving them with stock they can’t move. They have lost hundreds of thousands of dollars, and some have had to close. They can’t even walk away because they still have customers waiting to pick up guns. The 25000 that the government has offered to Dealers is a joke, and I don’t think any of the dealers have seen a cent of it.
The money being spent on this buy-back is a waste of my valuable tax-paying dollars. The only people handing in their guns will be doing it to make money. The quality of the firearm will be poor and definitely not dangerous. Some of the brand-new air rifles we sell are under $300, and you are offering $450 for what I can imagine will be rubbish. The advice the Government have sourced on firearms in this buy-back is unknown, but it appears to be from someone with no knowledge of firearms.
Some people who don’t shoot live in a naive existence of where their groceries come from. People who don’t realise that everything in the supermarket is protected by firearms do not care about the consequences of these firearm reforms. They probably naively believe that “no one needs guns”. But they will suffer too. They will realise this when the country is importing all its food because there are no farms, no farmers and our debts are rising. These reforms affect everyone and do not tackle the real issue.
Another unnecessary punishment brought on by these reforms is the time you can renew your licence for. 2 years is going to cost people more money than, say, QLD licences, which you can get issued for 10 years. Not just individually, but the extra workload on weapons licensing will fall on the public to pay. What purpose does it serve? Paying to renew more doesn’t ensure stronger public safety. If you commit a crime, you can lose your licence anyway, so how does renewing more frequently help? I believe it is to try to make it harder for already struggling families. Or to give more opportunity for people to forget to renew. How does this save people from terrorists? Can we please use our taxes to deliver harsher consequences to criminals and strengthen our borders so extremists and terrorists are not allowed in.

Agreed… nevertheless I offer this text… it’s not difficult to read when you understand it is precise. 

It’s not a warning, it’s a prophecy, and an endorsement of action.

“In contemplating the causes which may disturb our Union, it occurs as matter of serious concern that any ground should have been furnished for characterizing parties… whence designing men may endeavor to excite a belief that there is a real difference of local interests and views…

One of the expedients of party to acquire influence within particular districts is to misrepresent the opinions and aims of other districts. You cannot shield yourselves too much against the jealousies and heart burnings which spring from these misrepresentations.
They tend to render alien to each other those who ought to be bound together by fraternal affection…

They serve to organize faction, to give it an artificial and extraordinary force to put in the place of the delegated will of the nation the will of a party; often a small but artful and enterprising minority of the community; and, according to the alternate triumphs of different parties, to make the public administration the mirror of the ill concerted and incongruous projects of faction, rather than the organ of consistent and wholesome plans digested by
common councils and modified by mutual interests…

However combinations or associations of the above description may now and then answer popular ends, they are likely, in the course of time and things, to become potent engines by which cunning, ambitious, and unprincipled men will be enabled to subvert the power of the people and to usurp for themselves the reins of government, destroying afterwards the very engines which have lifted them to unjust dominion.

Towards the preservation of your government and the permanency of your present happy state, it is requisite, not only that you steadily discountenance irregular oppositions to its acknowledged authority, but also that you resist with care the spirit of innovation upon its principles, however specious the pretexts. One method of assault may be to effect in the forms of the Constitution alterations which will impair the energy of the system and thus to undermine what cannot be directly overthrown.

In all the changes to which you may be invited, remember that time and habit are at least as necessary to fix the true character of governments as of other human institutions; that experience is the surest standard by which to test the real tendency of the existing constitution of a country; that facility in changes, upon the credit of mere hypotheses and opinion, exposes to perpetual change from the endless variety of hypotheses and opinion; and remember, especially, that for the efficient management of your common interests in a country so extensive as ours, a government of as much vigor as is consistent with the perfect security of liberty is indispensable.”

-A President

Maryland Gov. Wes Moore accused in bizarre new scandal involving military, including fabricating friendship with dead soldier

Democratic Maryland Gov. Wes Moore published an inaccurate account of the death of a fellow soldier killed in Afghanistan and was dubbed a “f–king liar” by veterans who doubt he even knew the war hero, a new report said.

Moore — a 48-year-old potential presidential contender — wrote in his 2015 memoir that he wept over the death of comrade Army 1st Sgt. Tobias “Toby” Meister while at his own grandfather’s funeral Dec. 17, 2005, according to an exposé published in Spotlight on Maryland on Sunday.

Meister, an Oklahoma native, was actually alive at the time — and would be for another 11 days, dying in a roadside bombing in Afghanistan on Dec. 28, 2005.

“Inside that casket, I also saw Toby,” Moore wrote, referencing his grandfather’s funeral and his “friend” Meister in his autobiography “The Work: Searching for a Life That Matters,” according to the report.
“As I left the funeral I felt freer than when I’d arrived,” said Moore, who once lied about being a Bronze Star recipient.
Meister’s widow, Alicia Meister, told the outlet she has heard from many soldiers and dignitaries — including former President George W. Bush — in the wake of her husband’s death.

But she said she never heard from Moore — who was reelected to a second term in the Annapolis executive chamber earlier this month and is rumored to be eyeing a 2028 White House run — or heard his name mentioned as a friend of Toby’s until last week, when she spoke with Spotlight on Maryland.

I’ve never personally heard from him,” Alicia Meister said. “I don’t know who [Moore] is. I don’t recall my late husband ever talking about him.”

After the interview, the military widow said, Moore called to offer his respects before Spotlight published its piece.

Others close to Toby ripped the governor, who says he joined the Army at age 17 and left a finance career to serve as a director of information operations in Afghanistan when he was in his late 20s.

text:
Backend engineer comp at a late-stage startup (Series D+, 300-1500 people). Rough ranges, not anyone’s offer.

1) Level + scope (what moves the needle)
- Mid (L4): owns 1-2 services, on-call, ships features: base $160-210k, bonus 0-10%, equity $50-200k/4yr
- Senior (L5): owns a domain, drives reliability/latency, mentors: base $190-260k, bonus 5-15%, equity $150-500k/4yr
- Staff (L6): cross-team architecture, incident leadership, capacity planning: base $230-320k, bonus 10-20%, equity $300k-1.2M/4yr

2) Location
- SF/NYC/Seattle: often top of band
- Remote US: usually 5-20% lower base depending on company
- EU/UK: base can be 30-50% lower, sometimes offset by more equity (still less total)

3) Equity details that matter
- Options vs RSUs (late-stage is more likely RSUs)
- Strike price + current 409A
- Refreshers: 10-30% of initial grant each year is common for strong performance
- Liquidity: IPO timing vs secondary windows changes real value a lot

4) Bonus and on-call
- Bonus is usually smaller than big tech, but can show up as spot bonuses for incident-heavy quarters
- Heavy on-call (tier-1, nights/weekends) often correlates with higher bands, especially in infra/platform roles

5) Example total comp ranges (US, SF/Seattle)
- L4: ~$200-320k TC
- L5: ~$270-450k TC
- L6: ~$400-700k+ TC depending on equity and scope
